date: 14 October [1912?] (received stamp '14 OCT 12'; preamble '14/10' with filing hour 18)
title: Four-figure code telegram from 'Fouad' in Paris to the Khedive Abbas Hilmi II at the Hotel Imperial, Vienna, 143 groups on four sheets
correspondents: 'Fouad' (unidentified) to Abbas Hilmi II, Khedive of Egypt
language: unknown (code; clear close 'HOMMAGES DEVOUES' is French)
shelfmark: Durham University Library, Abbas Hilmi II Papers, HIL/57/77-80 (Crowned Heads)
folio_note: HIL/57/80 sheet I (header), 79 sheet II, 78 sheet III, 77 sheet IV; IIIF manifest frames 50, 49, 48, 47. Telegraph no. 27597, 153 words, received form D.S. Nr. 759 (1/1910), clerk stamp 'Teufelberger'.
status: 16 Nov 2026: groups read once from IIIF regions (~1,200 px), uncollated (research/sweep_2026-11-15_wave18_durham2/raw/hil57_77-80_groups.txt). Whole of HIL/57 (73 frames) screened: no clear copy or decode. Direct lookup in the Khedivial Cabinet code HIL/155 gives no text (0560 Arrive, 3063 S'etre entendu, 1316 Cessionnaire). HIL/150, 152, 154 not tried; no other file searched for a clear copy.
why: A complete 143-group four-figure code telegram to the Khedive, with several code books from the same papers digitised alongside (HIL/150-155), so a key or the book may be in the collection.
score_note: Repeats (3063 x5, 0560 x5, 3645 x4) suggest a code, possibly enciphered; candidate books in the same collection: HIL/155 with an additive or shift, HIL/150 (Ottoman code no. 75), HIL/152/154 (Arabic numbered codes). Sender and year need confirming.
verify: Collate the 143 groups at full resolution; read the stamp year; test HIL/155 with additives/offsets and the numbered Arabic and Ottoman codes HIL/152, 154, 150; identify 'Fouad' (Prince Ahmad Fuad? Kerim Fouad of HIL/51/122?); look for a clear copy in other HIL files of 1912 (e.g. HIL/21, 23-27, 67).
